rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi joining siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulaṃ

items.question: What additional attainments belong to the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The conjunction adds these to previously mentioned attainments.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: Eight attainments, including the attainment of powers, are included within the root Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact referents of the eight items are not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And there are eight, O fair-faced one, including the attainment of powers, which belong to the root Kaula.
